title: MIA 2022 Shared Task: Evaluating Cross-lingual Open-Retrieval Question Answering for 16 Diverse Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating cross-lingual open-retrieval question answering systems. While it discusses biases in data (e.g., English-centric bias and American-centric questions), it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component.
